rationale_paragraphs: San Francisco needs more than a victory here: the winning margin must exceed 7.5 points. APEX projects San Francisco ahead by approximately 8.1 points, compared with the 7.5-point spread. The engine combines the market line with team scoring history, quarterback performance, venue, and totals-market information. Its venue contribution shifts the projected margin approximately 0.60 points toward San Francisco, while the combined quarterback contributions move it 0.95 points toward Washington. The projected margin puts San Francisco beyond the cover threshold; converting that advantage into points is what matters for this selection.

rationale_paragraphs: Possessions create the opportunities; turning them into points determines this total. APEX projects approximately 20.5 combined possessions and 54.9 points for Washington and San Francisco, placing its scoring estimate 3.4 points above the line. The engine also accounts for how far the game can drift from that average: the middle 80% of its projected outcomes spans approximately 34 to 76 points. It then adds the probabilities of every combined score of 52 or higher to evaluate the over. Sustaining drives and finishing them with points is the key to reaching the over.
